density.calibration_disclosure: Targets are 8 locator-bearing heading paths and 20 locator occurrences per 1,000 indexable source words, measured by chapter as permissive calibration rather than quotas or hard ceilings.

distribution_findings.summary: All 17 chapters exceed the 6–10 target band for locator-bearing paths; 15 exceed the 4–12 broad tolerance band.
Locator-occurrence density is within the target band in 4 chapters and the broad tolerance band in 10 more; only CHUNK-009, CHUNK-011, and CHUNK-016 exceed the broad band.

Across 194,718 indexable words, the chapter-level sum is 3,063 path appearances and 5,338 locator occurrences (15.73 and 27.41 per 1,000 words), showing many short paths rather than proportionate expansion of page evidence.
